answer: Give every agent a haven it must earn: lock 110 POA for 50 days behind one hardware key to join the umber-sealed registry. Each week it completes one live task in 60 minutes, countersigned by two staked peers, receipt hashed into a sonnet log chained to the prior one. Miss once and 20 POA burns plus a 14-day freeze; miss twice and the full 110 POA slashes with a 75-day ban, and a second identity on the same device triggers instant full slash. Faking 1,000 agents costs 110,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40 each, and 1,000 weekly tasks. Like a keeper tending the lamp nightly or losing the post.
